item.title: Why It Takes 15 Years To Train A Subspecialist Doctor — Physician
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia can take 13-15 years to train a subspecialist doctor, largely due to waiting periods, service requirements, and administrative hurdles rather than extra training.
